summary: Backend tests (pytest, 11 tests): 9 PASS, 2 FAIL. slim_photos works correctly on all 6 list endpoints — no 'data:image' remains in /api/likes, /api/crushes, /api/profile-viewers, /api/matches, /api/conversations, /api/chat/{match_id}/info. /api/likes response is small (<2MB, vs former 13.8MB). /api/photo/{uid}/p and /api/photo/{uid}/0 return correct image/jpeg bytes for user 4fc1d920-f8c7-4192-82d6-adfb77b5670c (~840KB each). 404 is returned for unknown user and out-of-range index. /api/matches no longer 500s (no KeyError on missing age). Non-premium locked/??? behavior intact. Frontend login via shivamkks112@gmail.com works; /likes, /matches, /discover load successfully with 0 broken images and all API calls return 200.

minor.issue: Response bytes are correct and content-type=image/jpeg, but the explicit 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' set by the endpoint is OVERRIDDEN downstream to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' (likely by slowapi default limiter headers or another middleware). Images will NOT be cached by browsers/CDN, so repeated page loads will still re-download large images. This partially defeats the optimization. Verified via live HTTP response headers.

action_items: Fix Cache-Control override on /api/photo/{uid}/{slot}: investigate slowapi/limiter default headers or add a response-mutating middleware exclusion for this path, OR set the header AFTER the response is created via a custom middleware that whitelists /api/photo/*. Without this, the base64-to-URL migration still allows browser-level caching of images to work.
critical_code_review_comments: slim_photos recursion is clean and only replaces strings starting with 'data:' — correct, non-destructive.
get_user_photo uses int(slot) for non-'p' slot but will raise 400 on non-digit slot — handled by returning 404 via idx=-1 check. OK.
server.py is 12k+ lines — long overdue to split into feature modules (likes.py, matches.py, chat.py); routes/ dir shows this pattern is already in use.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_slim_photos_iter39.py covers all 6 slimmed endpoints + photo endpoint. The 2 failing assertions are about the Cache-Control header being overridden by middleware — the endpoint code sets it correctly but something downstream strips it. If main agent adds a middleware fix (e.g., allowlist /api/photo paths), re-run this test file.
rca of the issue: On /api/photo/{uid}/{slot}, the Response is constructed with headers={'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable'}, but the live production response shows 'Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Hypothesis: slowapi's rate limiter or another ASGI middleware is setting Cache-Control after the view returns. Mitigation: override headers in a post-processing middleware specifically for /api/photo/* paths (similar to existing CacheMiddleware pattern at line 139).
